$:set -eu
echo '=== VERIFY WORKFLOW REGISTRATION ==='
gh workflow view codespace-mcp-identifiers-members.yml --repo BestNameYet/Terminals
echo '=== VALIDATE FILES ==='
python3 - <<'PY'
import pathlib,subprocess,yaml
w=pathlib.Path('.github/workflows/codespace-mcp-identifiers-members.yml')
t=w.read_text()
assert '${{ fromJSON(needs.discover.outputs.matrix) }}' in t
assert '${{ matrix.repository }}' in t
assert '${{ matrix.revision }}' in t
assert 'timeout-minutes: 120' in t
v=yaml.safe_load(t)
assert set(v['jobs'])=={'discover','scan','merge'}
assert len(v['jobs']['scan']['steps'])==6
assert len(v['jobs']['merge']['steps'])==5
subprocess.run(['node','--check','workspaces/codespace-mcp-srs-design/expression-inventory/scan-identifiers-members.js'],check=True)
print('YAML_OK jobs',sorted(v['jobs']))
PY
echo '=== DISPATCH ==='
gh workflow run codespace-mcp-identifiers-members.yml --repo BestNameYet/Terminals --ref main
echo '=== RUNS ==='
gh run list --repo BestNameYet/Terminals --workflow codespace-mcp-identifiers-members.yml --limit 3 --json databaseId,createdAt,status,conclusion
